question: How many Kartavyas form the guiding framework of the Union Budget 2026–27?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Three.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• **The Union Budget 2026-27 is inspired by three Kartavyas that outline the government’s development priorities.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **The Union Budget 2026-27 is structured around three Kartavyas.**
 
• The first Kartavya focuses on accelerating and sustaining economic growth.
 
• The second Kartavya aims to fulfil aspirations and build the capacity of people.
 
• The third Kartavya aligns with the vision of Sabka Sath, Sabka Vikas, ensuring inclusive development.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• Kartavya Framework__

 __
 
• Kartavya refers to the duty-based approach adopted in the Union Budget 2026-27.
 
• It outlines the core responsibilities of the government towards growth, people and inclusivity.
 
 
 
• Economic Growth Kartavya__
 __
 
• Focuses on manufacturing, infrastructure, energy security and city development.
 
• Aims to enhance productivity, competitiveness and resilience.
 
 
 
• People-Centric Kartavya__
 __
 
• Emphasizes education, healthcare, skills, tourism and sports.
 
• Seeks to prepare citizens as active partners in national development.
 
 
 
• Inclusive Development Kartavya__
 
 
• Targets farmers, Divyangjan, mental health, and regional development.
 
• Ensures equitable access to resources and opportunities.
